DISCHARGE SUMMARY
Patient Maria Gonzalez, a [AGE]-year-old [GENDER], was admitted to [HOSPITAL] on [DATE] with chest pain and shortness of breath. Troponin was negative twice. Started on Lipitor 40 mg daily and aspirin 81 mg daily. Echocardiogram showed an ejection fraction of 55 percent. Follow up with cardiology in two weeks. Contact [PHONE] with any questions.
